summary: Backend + frontend testing for UMKM Finance & HPP MVP. Backend: 43/43 pytest cases pass covering auth, isolation, HPP accuracy (10-material canonical case exact numbers: material_total=6400, total_batch=9900, hpp/unit=990), dynamic recipe items (1/5/10/30/50, all persisted, item_count matches), unit conversion (kg->gram waste 0/5, kg qty), validation (yield 0, negative qty/price, empty recipe, insufficient stock, empty product name), full purchase/production/sale/expense chains, HPP snapshot immutability (old production HPP UNCHANGED after price hike, new production has higher HPP), cash flow accounting math (opening+in-out=closing), inventory summary + block negative adjust, all 11 report endpoints, dashboard, BEP (250 units / Rp 2.500.000), backup, CSV import template + preview, demo status. Frontend: login, dashboard KPIs & period filter work, Recipes CRUD flow works end-to-end (add 3 items, extra cost, realtime sum-material and sum-hpp-unit updates correctly, save persists), HPP calculator (product+recipe select loads items, yield edit updates HPP live, save works, calculations-table gets a new row), Produksi/Pembelian/Penjualan/Pengeluaran/BEP flows all succeed with UI-driven POSTs. Stok/Kas/Laba Rugi/Cash Flow pages load. Settings page tabs (5) render, Demo tab shows demo-status + demo-delete-btn. Mobile 390px: sidebar-toggle-btn is visible, no horizontal overflow. CRITICAL BUG detected on Reports page: switching between tabs (specifically to 'stok') throws JS runtime error `d.filter is not a function`, which crashes the page and hides subsequent tabs and export button. Root cause: useApi (lib/hooks.js) does not reset `data` when URL/deps change, so the previous endpoint's response (an object, e.g. from /reports/hpp) leaks into the next render of Reports Body where the 'stok' case calls `d.filter(...)` assuming an array from /inventory/summary.

ui_bugs.issue: Switching report tabs throws 'd.filter is not a function' runtime error, crashing the whole Reports page. Occurs because useApi keeps stale `data` across url/deps change; when new tab is 'stok', d is still an object from previous endpoint (e.g. /reports/hpp), and `case "stok": d.filter((r)=>r.item_type===...)` fails. Fix options: (a) in useApi, `setData(null)` at start of reload, (b) in Reports Body render, guard each case for expected shape (Array.isArray(d) or d?.summary) and show loading otherwise.

Expected `data-testid=export-csv-btn` is not present. Reports currently uses per-section DataTable CSV/Excel/Print buttons instead of a page-level export button. Either add master export-csv-btn OR update spec/testids to match.

On 390px viewport, clicking [data-testid=sidebar-toggle-btn] does not make nav items visible (nav-resep stayed hidden after toggle). Sidebar drawer may not open or animation state not applied. Please verify manually.

action_items: Fix Reports 'd.filter is not a function' crash: either reset data in useApi on deps change, or guard case bodies in Reports.jsx against stale/wrong-shape data.
Decide on Reports export-csv-btn: add a page-level export button with that data-testid, or update spec.
Fix mobile sidebar toggle so nav items become visible after clicking sidebar-toggle-btn at 390px width.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/hooks.js useApi does not clear `data` when url/deps change; consumers that switch endpoints (Reports) can render with a previous endpoint's shape and crash. Add `setData(null)` at reload start or expose an option.
Reports.jsx switch/case for 'stok' assumes `d` is an array without guard; every case should validate expected shape before dereferencing (e.g., d?.summary, Array.isArray(d)).
operations.py Purchase 'purchase_unit_qty' field is set to the purchase-unit string (should be numeric qty in that unit). Minor: naming/typing inconsistency in material_price_history record.
